description: An increasing chain is elementary if and only if each specified inclusion between successive stages is elementary.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ElementaryChains.IncreasingChain.isElementary_iff_successor.{u, v, w}
  {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w} [L.Structure M]
  (C : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ElementaryChains.IncreasingChain L M) :
  C.IsElementary ↔ ∀ (i : ℕ), ∃ e, ⇑e = ⇑(C.inclusion i (i + 1) ⋯)
